definition: A magnetic railgun scaled to transportation — launches pressurized pods at Mach 6-12 into suborbital arcs that cross continents in minutes. Meridian to Lagos in 14 minutes. Costs Φ800+ per ticket. The rich person's transit. 847 deployed worldwide.
origin: Engineering — electromagnetic linear accelerator adapted from military railgun technology to civilian transit
example: Caught the 0900 mass driver to Shanghai. Fourteen minutes of terror and one of weightlessness. The coffee in the Cradle lounge was better than the flight.
